content.en: Remove the normal start tile. Put the source in the middle, shuffle the ten middle river tiles, and place the lake at the bottom of that stack.
content.zh: 收起普通起始板块，将源头放在中央；洗混十块中段河流板块，并把湖泊放在牌堆最底部。

alt.en: Remove the start tile; place the source, shuffle the river, lake on the bottom
alt.zh: 收起起始板块；先放源头，洗河牌，湖泊放在牌堆底

title.en: Finish the river before land tiles

content.en: Players draw only river tiles until the lake is placed. Continue the river, match all other terrain normally, never make a U-turn with two consecutive bend tiles, and do not place meeples on the river itself.
content.zh: 湖泊放下前，玩家只抽河流板块。河流必须接续，其他地形照常匹配；连续两张弯河不能同向形成掉头，且不能把米宝放到河流本身。

alt.en: Place all 12 river tiles first; no U-turns; the river also splits fields
alt.zh: 先放完 12 张河牌；禁止掉头；河流也会分割田野

content.en: After all twelve river tiles are placed, draw normal land tiles and continue normally. The river divides fields, but it adds no new scoring rules.
content.zh: 十二块河流板块全部铺完后，改抽普通地形板块并按基础规则继续。河流会分割农田，但不增加额外计分规则。
